title: Grip Strength Tracker
description: Log dynamometer readings and compare against age and gender reference ranges.
howto: Select gender and enter your age.
Enter your dynamometer reading in kg and the hand tested.
Click Log reading to compare against the reference range.
Build a history log saved in your browser.

faqs.q: Where do the reference ranges come from?
faqs.a: Approximate typical ranges for dominant-hand grip by decade. They are illustrative, not clinical cut-offs.
With a hand dynamometer, arm at your side, elbow at 90 degrees, squeezing maximally. Take the best of 2-3 tries.
Test both, but the reference ranges reflect the dominant hand. Log which hand you used.
